summary: Completed frontend testing of Box Manager bilingual system (ITA/ENG) and dark mode. Most features work correctly: login, dashboard translations, dark mode toggle, Categories page, Containers page (BoxList), Search page, Backup page, Print page, and language persistence. However, found critical translation issues in BoxDetail.jsx and PasswordPage.jsx where text is hardcoded in Italian instead of using the translation system.

translation_issues.issue: Page title 'Gestione Contenuto/Oggetti' and description are hardcoded in Italian (line 318-321)
affected_text: Crea e organizza gli oggetti dei singoli contenitori (nome oggetto, descrizione, eventuale foto)

translation_issues.issue: Page title 'Impostazione utente e password' and all section titles/labels are hardcoded in Italian (line 123-125, 132-134, etc.)
affected_text: Consente di inserire il nome dell'utente...

affected_text: Il tuo browser non supporta l'accesso alla fotocamera.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The bilingual system (ITA/ENG) works correctly on most pages. The translations.js file contains 200+ translations for both languages. However, BoxDetail.jsx and PasswordPage.jsx have hardcoded Italian text and do not use the useLanguage() hook. The main agent needs to update these two components to use the translation system. All other pages (Dashboard, Categories, BoxList, Search, Backup, Print) correctly use the translation system.
